headline: Key Functions in helpers/general.go
what_breaks: deps/deps.go — relies on TCPListen() for network operations
resources/resource/resource_helpers.go — uses ReaderToString() for reading data
resources/page/permalinks.go — depends on GetTitleFunc() for title transformations
why: This file contains critical utility functions that are widely used across various components. Changes to these functions could lead to cascading failures in dependent files, affecting overall functionality.
checklist: Review changes to TCPListen() for impact on network listeners.
Ensure ReaderToString() modifications do not alter expected string outputs.
Validate GetTitleFunc() to maintain title case transformations.
